'''The Combat''' was the ritual contest held between the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of [[Rabaan]] and the [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]], the main inhabitants of the [[Ishanna system/Legends|Ishanna system]]. The Combat was held on the [[Combat Moon]] in Rabaan's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. When disputes occurred between Rabaan and S'Krrr, their best warrior was chosen to meet in single combat on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The combat was to the death, and the winner secured victory for their planet in the dispute.
